is_anopheles.evidence: Page 1: 'Status of insecticide resistance in Anopheles mosquitoes in Ubon Ratchathani province, Northeastern Thailand'

reports_target_markers.evidence: Page 1 and Page 8: DNA sequencing was performed to detect Vgsc L1014F and L1014S substitutions in the voltage-gated sodium channel gene.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 8: DNA sequencing of VGSC gene was performed on 48 amplicons (37 An. hyrcanus s.l. and 12 An. barbirostris s.l.). None presented L1014F or L1014S mutations.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 1 and Page 3: Mosquito collections were performed in Ubon Ratchathani province, Northeastern Thailand (Asia), not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field collection and laboratory susceptibility bioassays and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 3: Seven sites in five districts of Ubon Ratchathani province: Ban Pakla, Ban Talong, Ban Payaka, Ban Nongmek, Ban Sanghom, rubber plantation in Nachaluay district, Chong Ta Ou (with GPS coordinates given).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 3 and Table 1: Mosquitoes were collected between September 2013 and September 2015.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field collection data presented under the MALVEC research project.

supplement.evidence: All relevant genotyping and bioassay summary data are presented in the text, figures, and tables of the main manuscript.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site mutations (Vgsc 1014F/S) in Anopheles mosquitoes collected in Ubon Ratchathani province, Northeastern Thailand between 2013 and 2015. The paper is ineligible because the field populations are from Thailand, not Africa.
exclusion_reasons: The study examined mosquito populations collected in Thailand (Asia), not an African field population.
